name: Simple Greeting Workflow
description: A simple workflow that generates a greeting using the LLM

steps.name: Generate Greeting
steps.description: Ask the AI to generate a friendly greeting

llmConfig.systemPrompt: You are a friendly assistant. Always be concise and polite.
llmConfig.content: Hello! Please provide a brief, friendly greeting to a new user.

codeConfig.code: console.log('Generated greeting:', context.greeting); return { message: 'Greeting generated successfully', greeting: context.greeting };
